title: Live War Room và post-live highlights
scope_items: Database Migration 00030: Created live_sessions (§12.1), live_segments, cue_cards, highlights tables with composite workspace tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), check constraints, and narrow role-based grants.

Acceptance Target 1 (Reconnect does not duplicate commands): Reconnecting clients retransmitting command tokens or idempotency keys receive cached responses (is_duplicate: true) without duplicating cue cards, highlights, offer pins, or triggering duplicate state transitions.

Acceptance Target 2 (M07 extracts, M09 registers clips): Marked highlights extract timeframes via M07 extraction bridge and auto-register derivative clips into M09 with parent lineage (parent_asset_id, derivative_type='clip') and link highlights.asset_id back to the source live session.

Acceptance Target 3 (Revenue traceable and labeled): Live orders linked via orders.live_session_id form a verifiable bidirectional lineage chain Session -> Product -> Offer -> Order -> Revenue, producing immutable post-live proof summaries with source_class='live_attributed' using exact non-float arithmetic (NUMERIC(18,6) and BigInt micros).
Run-of-Show and Cues: JSONB run-of-show segment array supports pre-planning and dynamic live adjustment; cue cards trigger on target offsets with linked products and promotional offers.
Web and Mobile War Room Surfaces: Screen W109 Web Live War Room command center with CSR real-time triage, Screen W110 Post-Live Proof Summary, and Screen M055 Mobile Live War Room view.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestReconnectDoesNotDuplicateCommands (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm deduplication of retransmitted commands with cached responses.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestM07ExtractsAndM09RegistersClips (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm M07 extraction simulation and M09 derivative registration linking back to parent asset.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestRevenueTraceableAndLabeled (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm exact non-float revenue calculations and proof summary generation labeled live_attributed.

Lifecycle & Negative Transitions: TestLifecycleTransitionsAndTenantIsolation and TestLiveCommerceHandler_NegativePaths confirm strict state machine enforcement (planned -> live -> paused -> ended -> post_live_processing -> closed) and cross-tenant isolation.
Migration 00030 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 30 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: Vitest web test suite (33 files, 260 tests passing), svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), Vite production build (adapter-node ✔ done), real SSR smoke tests, and Flutter test suite (223 tests passing, flutter analyze 0 issues) all pass.
external_gates: Migration 00030 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.

Production live streaming integrates with external streaming CDNs/platforms (TikTok Live, Shopee Live); live war room command center, cue card orchestration, and post-live processing verified locally.
